SELECT 
    client_id,
    age,
    average_salary
FROM (
    SELECT 
        client_id,
        age,
        average_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC) AS oldest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY average_salary ASC) AS lowest_salary_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            client_id,
            age,
            average_salary
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                c.client_id,
                EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) AS age,
                d.A11 AS average_salary
            FROM 
                client c
            JOIN 
                district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
            WHERE 
                c.gender = 'F'
        )
    )
)
WHERE 
    oldest_rank = 1 OR lowest_salary_rank = 1;

                client c

    )
)

SELECT 
    client_id,
    age,
    average_salary
FROM (
    SELECT 
        client_id,
        age,
        average_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC) AS oldest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY average_salary ASC) AS lowest_salary_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            client_id,
            age,
            average_salary
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                c.client_id,
                EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) AS age,
                d.A11 AS average_salary
            FROM 
                client c
            JOIN 
                district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
            WHERE 
                c.gender = 'F'
        )
    )
)
WHERE oldest_rank = 1 OR lowest_salary_rank = 1;

    client_id,

    average_salary
FROM (

        client_id,
        age,
        average_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC) AS oldest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY average_salary ASC) AS lowest_salary_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            client_id,
            age,
            average_salary
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                c.client_id,
                EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) AS age,

                client c

                district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id

                c.gender = 'F'
        )
    )
)
WHERE oldest_rank = 1 OR lowest_salary_rank = 1;

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region;

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
overall_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans_overall,
        SUM(loans_with_no_issues) AS total_loans_with_no_issues_overall
    FROM 
        loans_with_no_issues
)
SELECT 
    t.region,
    t.loan_size_category,
    t.total_loans,
    l.loans_with_no_issues,
    (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage_with_no_issues,
    (os.total_loans_with_no_issues_overall * 100.0 / os.total_loans_overall) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    total_loans t
JOIN 
    loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
CROSS JOIN 
    overall_stats os;

sql:
SELECT 
    t1.region,
    t1.loan_size_category,
    t1.total_loans,
    t2.loans_with_no_issues,
    (t2.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t1.total_loans) AS percentage_with_no_issues
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) AS t1
JOIN 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) AS t2
ON t1.region = t2.region AND t1.loan_size_category = t2.loan_size_category;

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: WITH total_loans AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), loans_with_no_issues AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 AND loan.status = 'C' GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), percentage AS (SELECT t.region, t.loan_size_category, (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage FROM total_loans AS t JOIN loans_with_no_issues AS l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category) SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average FROM percentage ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: WITH total_loans AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), loans_with_no_issues AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 AND loan.status = 'C' GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), percentage AS (SELECT t.region, t.loan_size_category, (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage FROM total_loans AS t JOIN loans_with_no_issues AS l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category) SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average FROM percentage ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: WITH total_loans AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), loans_with_no_issues AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 AND loan.status = 'C' GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), percentage AS (SELECT t.region, t.loan_size_category, (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage FROM total_loans AS t JOIN loans_with_no_issues AS l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category) SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average FROM percentage ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: WITH total_loans AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), loans_with_no_issues AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 AND loan.status = 'C' GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), percentage AS (SELECT t.region, t.loan_size_category, (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage FROM total_loans AS t JOIN loans_with_no_issues AS l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category) SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average FROM percentage ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM (
    WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region
)
ORDER BY 
    region;

SELECT 
    AVG(percentage_with_no_issues) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        (t2.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t1.total_loans) AS percentage_with_no_issues
     FROM 
        (SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
         FROM 
            loan
         JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
         JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
         JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
         WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
         GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END) AS t1
     JOIN 
        (SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
         FROM 
            loan
         JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
         JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
         JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
         WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
         GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END) AS t2
     ON t1.region = t2.region AND t1.loan_size_category = t2.loan_size_category);

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region, loan_size_category)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region, loan_size_category)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, overall_average FROM (WITH total_loans AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), loans_with_no_issues AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 AND loan.status = 'C' GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), percentage AS (SELECT t.region, t.loan_size_category, (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage FROM total_loans AS t JOIN loans_with_no_issues AS l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category) SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average FROM percentage ORDER BY region, loan_size_category) ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'

        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues

        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id

        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id

    WHERE

        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'

),

    l.loans_with_no_issues,
    (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage_with_no_issues,
    o.overall_percentage
FROM 
    total_loans t
JOIN 
    loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
CROSS JOIN 
    overall_stats o;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region, loan_size_category)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

    AVG(UA) AS "Average UA Index"
FROM 
    (
        WITH LatestLabResults AS (
            SELECT 
                Patient.ID, 
                Laboratory.UA, 
                Patient.SEX,
                Laboratory.Date AS LabDate
            FROM 
                Patient
            JOIN 
                Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
            QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Patient.ID ORDER BY Laboratory.Date DESC) = 1

        SELECT 
            ID, 
            UA, 
            SEX
        FROM 
            LatestLabResults
        WHERE 
            (SEX = 'M' AND UA < 8.0) OR (SEX = 'F' AND UA < 6.5)

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region, loan_size_category)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, overall_average FROM (WITH total_loans AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), loans_with_no_issues AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 AND loan.status = 'C' GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), percentage AS (SELECT t.region, t.loan_size_category, (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage FROM total_loans AS t JOIN loans_with_no_issues AS l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category) SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average FROM percentage ORDER BY region, loan_size_category) ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region, loan_size_category)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, overall_average FROM (WITH total_loans AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), loans_with_no_issues AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 AND loan.status = 'C' GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), percentage AS (SELECT t.region, t.loan_size_category, (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage FROM total_loans AS t JOIN loans_with_no_issues AS l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category) SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average FROM percentage ORDER BY region, loan_size_category) ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage_with_no_issues,
    overall_percentage
FROM 
    (
        WITH total_loans AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS total_loans
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        loans_with_no_issues AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
                AND loan.status = 'C'
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        overall_stats AS (
            SELECT 
                20242.0 / 46579.0 * 100 AS overall_percentage
            FROM 
                (SELECT 1) AS dummy
        )
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage_with_no_issues,
            o.overall_percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
        CROSS JOIN 
            overall_stats o
    ) AS final;

            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM

        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN

        WHERE

            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'

            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN

            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END

    )

        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region, loan_size_category)
ORDER BY

sql:
WITH colusa AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(Case When Charter = 1 Then 1 Else 0 End) AS TotalCharterSchools,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5) AS HighFRPMCount,
        (SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgFreeMealCount,
        (SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgEnrollment
    FROM 
        schools
    JOIN 
        frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm."School Code"
    WHERE 
        schools.County = 'Colusa'
),
humboldt AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(Case When Charter = 1 Then 1 Else 0 End) AS TotalCharterSchools,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5) AS HighFRPMCount,
        (SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgFreeMealCount,
        (SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgEnrollment
    FROM 
        schools
    JOIN 
        frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm."School Code"
    WHERE 
        schools.County = 'Humboldt'
),
sat_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        County, 
        AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS AvgTotalSATScore
    FROM 
        schools
    JOIN 
        satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
    WHERE 
        County IN ('Colusa', 'Humboldt')
    GROUP BY 
        County
)
SELECT 
    'Colusa' AS County,
    TotalSchools,
    TotalCharterSchools,
    HighFRPMCount,
    AvgFreeMealCount,
    AvgEnrollment,
    COALESCE(sat_scores.AvgTotalSATScore, 0) AS AvgTotalSATScore
FROM 
    colusa
LEFT JOIN 
    sat_scores ON colusa.County = sat_scores.County
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Humboldt' AS County,
    TotalSchools,
    TotalCharterSchools,
    HighFRPMCount,
    AvgFreeMealCount,
    AvgEnrollment,
    COALESCE(sat_scores.AvgTotalSATScore, 0) AS AvgTotalSATScore
FROM 
    humboldt
LEFT JOIN 
    sat_scores ON humboldt.County = sat_scores.County;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    ROUND((gold_cards_before_1998 * 100.0 / total_gold_cards), 2) AS percentage_before_1998
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        region,
        COUNT(*) AS total_gold_cards,
        SUM(CASE WHEN issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gold_cards_before_1998
     FROM 
        (SELECT 
            c.card_id,
            c.issued,
            d.A3 AS region
         FROM 
            card c
         JOIN 
            disp dis ON c.disp_id = dis.disp_id
         JOIN 
            client cl ON dis.client_id = cl.client_id
         JOIN 
            district d ON cl.district_id = d.district_id
         WHERE 
            c.type = 'gold') AS gold_cards
     GROUP BY 
        region) AS region_counts;

WITH colusa AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(Case When Charter = 1 Then 1 Else 0 End) AS TotalCharterSchools,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5) AS HighFRPMCount,
        (SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgFreeMealCount,
        (SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgEnrollment
    FROM 
        schools
    JOIN 
        frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm."School Code"
    WHERE 
        schools.County = 'Colusa'
),
humboldt AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(Case When Charter = 1 Then 1 Else 0 End) AS TotalCharterSchools,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5) AS HighFRPMCount,
        (SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgFreeMealCount,
        (SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") / COUNT(*)) AS AvgEnrollment
    FROM 
        schools
    JOIN 
        frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm."School Code"
    WHERE 
        schools.County = 'Humboldt'
),
sat_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        County, 
        AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS AvgTotalSATScore
    FROM 
        schools
    JOIN 
        satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
    WHERE 
        County IN ('Colusa', 'Humboldt')
    GROUP BY 
        County
)
SELECT 
    'Colusa' AS County,
    TotalSchools,
    TotalCharterSchools,
    HighFRPMCount,
    AvgFreeMealCount,
    AvgEnrollment,
    COALESCE(sat_scores.AvgTotalSATScore, 0) AS AvgTotalSATScore
FROM 
    colusa
LEFT JOIN 
    sat_scores ON colusa.County = sat_scores.County
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Humboldt' AS County,
    TotalSchools,
    TotalCharterSchools,
    HighFRPMCount,
    AvgFreeMealCount,
    AvgEnrollment,
    COALESCE(sat_scores.AvgTotalSATScore, 0) AS AvgTotalSATScore
FROM 
    humboldt
LEFT JOIN 
    sat_scores ON humboldt.County = sat_scores.County;

sql:
SELECT 
    AVG(percentage_with_no_issues) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        (t2.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t1.total_loans) AS percentage_with_no_issues
     FROM 
        (SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
         FROM 
            loan
         JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
         JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
         JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
         WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
         GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END) AS t1
     JOIN 
        (SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
         FROM 
            loan
         JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
         JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
         JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
         WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
         GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END) AS t2
     ON t1.region = t2.region AND t1.loan_size_category = t2.loan_size_category);
